page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. No printed marginal notes. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. A handwritten pencil note in the right margin and a library stamp are not transcribed.

main_text.p: riam excidij totius regni Israel per Regem Assyrio-rum Salmanasar, à morte Peka[?] regnante Hosea, habes 2.Reg.17. Ad prophetæ uerba accedamus. Verbum misit Dominus.)Titulus seu argumentu noui loci. Clarè enim monstrat, nouam institui prophetiam contra regnum Israel. Misit, inquit, Dominus uerbum in Iacob, & ita etiam cecidit siue perfectum est in Iacob seu Israel, sicut uidelicet Dominus prænuntiari iusserat. Iacob & Israel pro populo decem tribuu, sicut etiam mox Ephraim & Samaria.

Et scient uniuersi.)Statim incipit peccata quaedam obijcere.Ac primò quidem agit generatim contra superbiam & fastum, maximè eorum qui in humanas uires, opes, & auxilia confidebant. Certù uerò est, plurima irrepsisse peccata in regnu Israel, præsertim cum idololatriæ, propter quam finit Deus in errores & cæcitatem labi, essent deditii, de quibus merito fuisset prophetæ agendum: sed placuit ea potissimum perstringere, quæ maximè in conspectu fuerunt, idq; post acceptã cladem à Thiglath Pelesser, ex qua certè debuissent occasionem arripere agendi pœnitentiam, & uitā emendandi. Nam post cladem illam uerosimile est prophetā ad uaticinādum contra eos esse missum. Huc enim pertinet uerba illa per mimesin recitata, plena omni fastu atq; arrogātia: Lateres ceciderunt, & politis lapidibus ædificabimus, &c. Quæ sanè de damno accepto à Thiglath Pelesser accipi conuenit. Id uerò se adhuc egregiè

page.notes: Catchword "sarturos" is doubtful: the long s is hard to separate from f, and the word may be another form. The pencil note "Tribus.10" in the right margin is handwriting and is not transcribed. The library stamp is not transcribed. "Peka" is followed by a mark that may be a letter or a line joiner; read as Peka[?]. Long s has been transcribed as plain s throughout.
